methodology.coverage: Every active public-default ranking recalculated; current evidence metadata and four recovered saved exports compared. Editorial conclusions are in the companion review.
methodology.qualityOnly: Same seven ratings and current weights, all ranked entries recalculated with length disabled. Diagnostic only, not corrected scores or approved replacement ranks.
methodology.historicalComparison: Archive mismatches are evidence gaps, not proof the current rating is wrong. Research-reviewed records intentionally supersede old material.
methodology.recoveredEdits: Matching an exported override establishes saved provenance, not who made it or whether it was correct. Absence from these four files does not establish AI authorship.
methodology.ties: Ranks follow the application: rounded score descending, then English alphabetical title. Tied ordinal positions do not indicate a quality difference.
methodology.dominance: A strict final-score advantage despite the lower entry having equal-or-higher ratings in every dimension and a higher rating in at least one. This diagnoses the separate duration preference, not an arithmetic failure.
